column1: # What the line answers besides a room's call, as Phiora does
# (puikit: app/phiora-server), so a page pointed at the line gets its
# config and keeps its own documents there: a name, a value.
# The first part of each path: an app's own document, who the page
# belongs to, and a person's saved documents. `alias` rows are older
# spellings of a first part that still answer.
# Where the apps' own files are, from this crate's folder, and an app's
# document in it ({key} is the app). The setting of the system named by
# `given`, when it is set, is the folder instead.
# What `me` says of a person, as a page reads it.
# The statuses of a document that was read, and of one that was kept.
